phases.name: Rebase planner, general-research, and general-implementation in core
Rebase both Neovim agents in nvim/index-entries.json
Rebase both Nix agents in nix/index-entries.json
Drop orphaned general-research hooks in memory/index-entries.json
Regenerate and measure all eight post-rebase totals
Rewrite the EXCEPTIONS block with measured floors

file_scope_deviation.reason: general-research-agent carries 2,832 tokens from two memory-extension entries (project/memory/distill-usage.md 2,376 + project/memory/domain/memory-reference.md 456) that its own .md body never references. The research report's 7,160-token floor for this agent counted core-file entries only. Without editing this fourth file the agent lands at 9,992 against an 8,000 cap and cannot pass. The edit is the identical orphan-hook correction applied in every other phase, and both entries retain their commands hooks so no real reach is lost.

constraints: load_when.skills does NOT exist. index.schema.json closes load_when (additionalProperties: false) over exactly agents/always/commands/task_types, and records that skills was deliberately removed as never-queried at runtime. Use on_demand: true instead for entries whose hooks become empty.

load_when.agents is a live by-agent-name discovery query for 5 of the 8 agents (general-research, general-implementation, planner, meta-builder, neovim-research) and inert catalog metadata for the other 3 (neovim-implementation, nix-implementation, nix-research). Do not assume uniform runtime behavior; verify per agent before dropping a hook.
Do NOT raise any CAPS value. A cap set to current usage retires the check as an instrument. Every reduction must be a hook-shape correction or an accurately computed documented exception.
An entry left with all load_when hooks empty MUST get on_demand: true in the same edit, or it fails the Dead Entry Check.

The deployed .claude/context/index.json carries 2 ghost entries with no source-store owner (orchestration/orchestration-validation.md, 1,864 tok hooked to meta-builder-agent; orchestration/subagent-validation.md, 2,504 tok unhooked). install-extension.sh merges additively so no source edit removes them. Hand-summed source entries will NOT equal validator output; carry +1,864 on meta-builder-agent as a known constant offset.

validate-context-budgets.sh applies an exception only when total_tokens <= exception_cap. Exception caps MUST be written from Phase 7 measured values, never estimates. This is precisely why the existing exception (8,048 vs a measured 68,568) has been inert.
index-entries.json and validate-context-budgets.sh are deliverables outside specs/**. No task-number citations in any added text; cite file names and token composition as durable anchors.
Edit agent-system/extensions/** only. .claude/** is a disposable deploy artifact regenerated from source; the regenerated index.json is an output, not an edit target.
verification_bar: bash .claude/scripts/validate-context-budgets.sh reports Violations: 0 and exits 0, with exactly three OK* documented-exception rows (general-implementation-agent, neovim-implementation-agent, nix-implementation-agent) whose declared caps and justifications are computed from Phase 7 measured totals and current file sizes. No CAPS value changed from baseline. Tier 1, Tier Classification, Dead Entry, and Double-Loading checks each no worse than baseline. check-task-references.sh and check-extension-docs.sh pass.
key_findings: Baseline re-measured at plan time: 8 violations, per-agent numbers matching the research report's Finding 1 table exactly.

Verified structural floor: neovim-implementation-agent and nix-implementation-agent genuinely @-reference the full core bundle (return-metadata-file 4,768 + progress-file 2,160 + summary-format 608 + phase-closure 856 + pre-edit-gate 856 = 9,248 tok) despite none of it being hooked to them today. 9,248 alone exceeds their 8,000 cap, so correcting this under-inclusion honestly is why they cannot pass by narrowing.

standards/git-staging-scope.md (2,624 tok) is hooked to neovim-implementation-agent and nix-implementation-agent but @-referenced by neither; drop from both (the entry lives in the core file, so the edit belongs to Phase 3).

CORRECTION to research: patterns/context-discovery.md (3,000 tok) is hooked to meta-builder-agent ONLY, not to the four agents the report's commands[] conversion recommendation assumed. That conversion is optional hygiene, not a required reduction for planner-agent or general-research-agent.

Verified droppable at stated token cost: patterns/task-lock.md (9,336, prose reference only) from general-implementation-agent; the four skill-lifecycle entries skill-preflight-flow (624) + skill-postflight-flow (1,008) + skill-self-execution-fallback (496) + lit-stage4a-flow (1,864) from general-research/planner/general-implementation; postflight-tool-restrictions (1,728) from general-implementation; status-markers (3,304) agents[] hook from planner and general-implementation (its commands[] hook already covers /plan, /implement, /task).

nix-research-agent's research-computed floor is exactly 8,000 with zero margin; the plan additionally moves project/nix/README.md (808 tok) off the agents[] hook so line-count drift cannot silently re-break the check.
follow_ups_identified: Shrink the shared core bundle, chiefly formats/return-metadata-file.md (596 lines / 4,768 tok, 59% of the 8,000 cap, referenced by 7 of the 8 overrun agents). This is the structural unblocker that would let the three exception agents pass without an exception.
Fold the content-duplication pairs patterns/metadata-file-return.md and patterns/early-metadata-pattern.md into formats/return-metadata-file.md.
Extend the Double-Loading Check to catch reverse-direction redundancy (agents[] fully subsumed by commands[] routing), which status-markers.md exhibits today and the check misses.

Fix the additive-merge ghost-entry defect in install-extension.sh's merge_index_entries, and remove the two stranded deployed files .claude/context/orchestration/orchestration-validation.md and subagent-validation.md.
